_source: ops/ux-2026-09-12/jevbench/AVAILABILITY.md (supervisor's JevBench job, 2026-09-19), 'Not measured, with the reason' table, text verbatim
note: An exclusion here is an availability fact about our run, never a quality claim about the project.

not_measured.author: IkerMoel
not_measured.reason: Reached, and it answers correctly - but its Hugging Face Space runs on ZeroGPU, whose free quota ran out after a handful of decisions, anonymously and again signed in with our own account. The Space's own message points at a paid Hugging Face PRO subscription; we do not buy one without Florian. Running the Qwen3.5-4B weights ourselves needs about 8 GB, over this job's 4 GB bound. Six answers are kept as evidence of the attempt and are deliberately not in the table.

not_measured.author: Bespoke Labs
not_measured.reason: Needs an NVIDIA GPU (~18 GB for the 9B weights, per the README) and there is no public endpoint. Our RunPod API returns HTTP 403 with Cloudflare `error code: 1010`, a bot rejection; we do not change client identity to get past one, so no GPU could be rented.

not_measured.author: Theodore Lee (TheoLeeCJ)
not_measured.reason: README: "Python 3.10+, CUDA, and a GPU that can hold a 4B BF16 model". The alternative is a browser-only WebGPU demo, which is not a programmable endpoint. No GPU available (see above).

not_measured.author: Dasein Labs
not_measured.reason: MLX on Apple Silicon. The README itself says "there is no container path because Linux containers cannot reach the Apple GPU". We have no Apple hardware.

not_measured.author: JoshuaSP
not_measured.reason: DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B measured on an H100 through the author's own Modal account. No public endpoint, no GPU on our side.

not_measured.author: razorback16 / Codiv
not_measured.reason: README: "at least 24 GB of memory for the NVFP4 checkpoint". The hosted route, codiv.ai, returns HTTP 403 to us and we hold no account there.

not_measured.author: Mikhail Rakutko (r-ms)
not_measured.reason: README: "~9 GB of disk for the weights … the 4B model needs about 8.5 GB of memory" plus Apple Silicon or CUDA. Over our 4 GB memory bound and our disk headroom.

not_measured.author: Sean Goedecke
not_measured.reason: Frozen Qwen3-8B scored locally; same memory and GPU wall, no public endpoint.

not_measured.author: Akash Kamat
not_measured.reason: The base model is gated: the README requires accepting Google's Gemma licence on Hugging Face first. We do not accept binding terms on Florian's behalf.

not_measured.author: Vincent Wang-Maścianica
not_measured.reason: The released checkpoints are the Doom and chess vision scorers; there is no released general text-decision checkpoint to run against this suite.

not_measured.author: Alex Wortega
not_measured.reason: A three-way NLI head (entailment / contradiction / neutral) plus task-specific heads. Turning that into a distribution over our arbitrary label sets needs an assumption we would then be measuring instead of the model.

not_measured.author: Cactus Compute
not_measured.reason: Its interface returns a chosen label plus one accept/refuse confidence, not a distribution over the exact label set, and we do not synthesize a distribution from a confidence scalar. Measured separately on the same 78 routing tasks in our earlier head-to-head (`~/jobs/needle3-vs-jev-20260918`): 0/78 category accuracy, ~4.2 s median on the same CPU.

not_measured.author: Fastino
not_measured.reason: A multi-label classification head. Its per-label scores are not a categorical posterior over our label set without choosing a normalization, and that choice would drive the calibration number. Kept as a candidate for a later version with a documented mapping.

not_measured.author: Pedro Marques
not_measured.reason: A trained router over three fixed GPT settings, not a general typed-decision interface. In `MARKET.md`, not in the suite.

not_measured.author: various
not_measured.reason: Applications built on a decision model, not decision models. In `MARKET.md`.
